build.warning: Section names are scrambled differently in every build (previous build: .text1/.code). Pick the scan range by RVA 0x1000 / first executable section, never by name.

scan_rules: every signature below matched exactly once in the game-code section AND exactly once across all executable sections, except WorldSingleton_ref (14 matches, same target)
none of the targets is a Denuvo jmp-stub nor inside .00cfg

GameTime_Get.notes: Returns current game time (region-local override if the owner is in a region with its own clock, else the global published clock extrapolated by real time * rate). 169 callers.

GameTime_Publish.proto: void __fastcall GameTime_Publish(void* timeMgr, const GameTime* t, bool r8, bool r9)
GameTime_Publish.notes: Copies the 32-byte GameTime into the published global (one of two copies chosen by TLS byte gs:[0x58]->[0]+0x1EB) then propagates. Callers: SetTimeOfDay wrappers 0xB3E990/0xB3ED00/0xB3EE60 and 0xC9B820 (mgr=[rcx+0x11A0]).

GameTime_SetTimeOfDay.proto: void __fastcall SetTimeOfDay(void* timeMgr, uint8 hour, uint8 minute, uint8 second, bool noDayAdvance /*stack +0x28*/)
GameTime_SetTimeOfDay.notes: Reads current time via GameTime_Get([timeMgr+0x20]->[0]), advances the day if the target time is not later than now (unless flag), then publishes. Caller 0xA2BF9F uses (12,0,0) i.e. set noon.

GameTime_ToLinear.notes: linear = day*75,600,000 + enc(msOfDay); enc: t<3h -> t/2; 3h..21h -> t-5.4e6; >=21h -> (t+64.8e6)/2. Night (21:00-03:00) runs at 2x speed. Constants inlined in ~110 other functions.

GameTime_FromLinear.notes: Inverse of ToLinear; also writes weekday = day % 7 at +0x14.

WeatherManager_Update.hook: detour, post-call writes (main seasonal weather hook)
WeatherManager_Update.notes: Single caller 0x3DEAAD0 (world env update, this=[world+0xF70]). If this->_isManualWeather(+0x31) applies manual weather, then calls WeatherManager_Compose(this), then consumes [this+0x60]->+0x20 (composed WeatherConstant, pointer is WC+0x28).

WeatherManager_Compose.notes: Weather layer compositor (CrimsonWeather calls it WeatherCompose). Single caller inside WeatherManager_Update at +0x54.

Weather_GetRainIntensity.notes: Returns WC._rain (+0x198) raw when manual (this+0x31), else multiplied by 1-clamp(([this+0x100]+0xCC - [[this+0x60]+0x28]+0xBC)/k,0,1). Exact-offset signature (sister of GetSnow).

Weather_GetDustIntensity.notes: Reads hour-like value via [this+0x100]->vtbl+0x100 and cvars at 0x71A8F90/0x71A8FE0/0x71A9030 (+0x38).

WeatherTick.notes: CrimsonWeather "WeatherTick": accumulates dt, queries rain via [world+0xF70], switches state ids (+0xFC/+0x100), drives effects via [world+0xF78]. Place to bias weather-state choice; semantics need probe.

GameTimeGlobals_ref.resolve: A=match+8+i32(match+4) (copy used when TLS flag set); B=match+18+i32(match+14) (default copy)
GameTimeGlobals_ref.notes: Two published GameTime structs (32 bytes): A=0x6E9C9B8, B=0x6E9C998 in this build.

WorldEnv_CallWeatherUpdate.resolve: call target = match+12+i32(match+8) == WeatherManager_Update; weather manager offset in world object = u32(match+3) (0xF70)

WorldSingleton_ref.resolve: global = match+7+i32(match+3) (0x70CAE20); world = (*global)->vtbl[0x60/8](*global); weatherMgr=[world+0xF70]; [world+0xF78]=weather effect/sim owner
WorldSingleton_ref.notes: Accept multiple matches only if all resolve to the same global.
